package_claims_verified: Counts verified by direct inspection of the extracted ZIP's catalog/*.json: 66 screens, 340 panels, 41 forms, 284 fields, 170 actions, 1270 test_cases, 36 journeys, 280 api_contracts. All match the delivery's own stated numbers exactly.
scope_reality: 66 screens across 4 interfaces is far larger than any single session can implement with this build's own standing practice (real tests, load-bearing verification of every safety-critical invariant) in one pass. Building incrementally, screen-by-screen / phase-by-phase, exactly as every other phase in this project has been built -- never claiming a screen is done until it has real DB-backed queries/commands and real passing tests.

current_slice.name: AD-07 (Products and portfolio versions, admin) + PU-02 (public portfolio catalog)
current_slice.why_this_slice_first: This is the package's own docs/12_BUILDABLE_DATA_AND_REPOSITORIES.md 'First actual vertical slice', and matches the user's own explicit request: an operator creates a genuine unpublished Product draft, saves it, reloads it, and sees the exact prerequisites blocking publication; the public catalog stays truthfully empty; a cross-tenant draft URL returns scoped not-found.
what_was_built: app/services/product_admin.py -- list/get/create/update + compute_publication_blockers (named, never collapsed) + list_published_products
app/db.py -- bespoke 'product_visibility' RLS policy (tenant match OR published), separate from the generic per-tenant-table policy, since PU-02 needs cross-tenant visibility for published rows only

app/api/dashboard_routes.py + app/templates/{_base,ad07_products,ad07_product_detail,pu02_catalog}.html -- real HTTP routes: GET/POST /ops/products, GET/POST /ops/products/{id}, GET /portfolios (anonymous)
alembic/versions/db545234a3c1_add_products_table.py -- real migration, verified end-to-end with a live disposable Postgres cluster (table + RLS policy both confirmed present via psql)

tests/test_product_admin.py (16 tests) + tests/test_dashboard_routes.py (10 tests) -- includes a raw-RLS test independent of product_admin.py's own tenant_id filtering, and load-bearing-verified: both the stale-revision guard and the product_visibility policy were each temporarily broken and confirmed to fail the relevant test before being restored
current_slice.deliberately_not_built: No publish/release-review route or action exists anywhere in this slice -- AD-07's own 'Confirm: Submit version for review; not directly publish' is a separate, distinct admission decision (app/services/publication_admission.py) this screen has no authority over. No multi-step wizard UI (Identity -> Sleeves/weights -> ... -> Preview) -- a single edit form covers the modeled fields; full 66-screen visual/interaction fidelity is out of scope for this bounded first slice.

second_slice.name: AD-02 (Rights and service approvals, admin) -- read-only grant register
second_slice.why_this_slice: RightsGrant (Phase 01) already models exactly what the spec's grant register needs (uses/channels/jurisdictions/assets/effective/expiry/status); a real read-only list is honestly buildable now. Create/attach-evidence/approve are NOT built -- they need private document upload + malware-scan infrastructure and an audit-logged owner-only approval workflow that don't exist yet, so building an empty create form around them would be scaffolding around nothing.
what_was_built: app/services/rights_registry.py -- list_rights_grants (platform-wide, no tenant_id on RightsGrant, gated by role not RLS)
app/services/permissions.py -- 'view_rights_register' action (owner/reviewer only, deliberately not researcher)

tests/test_rights_registry.py (+2) + tests/test_dashboard_routes.py (+4) -- empty state, real listing, and permission-denial; the permission guard was load-bearing-verified (temporarily widened, confirmed the denial test failed, restored)
second_slice.deliberately_not_built: AD-02-A01 (create grant draft), AD-02-A02 (attach evidence), AD-02-A03 (submit approval) -- no draft/revision lifecycle on RightsGrant, no evidence-document storage, no approval audit log.

screens_not_started: 63 of 66 (AD-02 partially done) -- see signal_platform_dashboard_v2/catalog/screens.json for the full list.
standing_constraints_from_master_prompt: No live orders/cancellations, customer charges/subscriptions, live publication, production resets, credential rotation, or unapproved infrastructure spending.
Isolated synthetic fixtures are authorized only in test/browser databases, never seeded into production.
Reuse existing FastAPI + Jinja2/Chart.js/Tabulator conventions -- no React/Dash rewrite, no second frontend server, no second trading engine.
Private signal-copier (SQLite, owner auth) stays separate from signal-portfolio-commercial (Postgres, tenant auth) -- commercial owner is never private trading authority.
Every action needs real role/tenant/object/state checks derived from the authenticated principal, never a caller-supplied tenant_id.
Missing external credentials/accounts block only external qualification, never the independently buildable UI/service work.
User's own standing instruction (carried from Phase 08): everything stays paper-traded; notify before anything is ready for promotion to live.
